author: N6rL
content:
## Plan

### tests/m1_integration.rs — 7-test M1 battery

**Shared helpers**: vault_config, collect_notes, M1Fixture struct, seed_m1_library (seeds academic_pdf + web_article + annotation + unknown, returns all 4 IDs).

**Tests**:
1. vault_has_one_note_per_ko — 4 KOs → rebuild → 4 .md files
2. delete_rebuild_combined — seed all 4, delete vault, rebuild, assert diff empty (combined §6 #5 proof)
3. annotation_survives_combined — confirms annotation note is present in both rebuilds (combined §9.4 proof with the full fixture set)
4. vault_rebuild_makes_zero_llm_calls — remove ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from env, rebuild succeeds without it (documents the M1 done-condition)
5. exact_match_dedup_no_new_object — ingest paper twice with same hash → second ingest returns LibraryError::IdentityResolution; library still has 1 paper object
6. version_update_updates_note — ingest paper v1 (title 'Paper v1') + rebuild; ingest paper v2 (same DOI, new hash, title 'Paper v2') + rebuild; assert note now contains 'Paper v2'
7. query_content_type_filter — seed 4 KOs; query(content_type=AcademicPdf) returns exactly 1 ID matching the paper

### Mutant testing (ADR-006)
cargo mutants --manifest-path alcanzai-core/Cargo.toml -F 'resolve_identity|ingest|render_note|write_relationship' (limit to the most critical functions). Record caught/escaped/total in closing comment.

### Closing comment
- All 7 tests passing
- Mutant count (caught / total)
- M1 done-conditions 1–5 self-checked
- Close #20 → close #12 epic
